vulnerabilities.title: Unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization header in requests
vulnerabilities.description: Requests before 2.31.0 leaks Proxy-Authorization headers to destination servers when following redirects.

vulnerabilities.title: urllib3 request body leak on redirect
vulnerabilities.description: urllib3 before 1.26.18 does not strip Cookie headers on cross-site HTTP redirects.

vulnerabilities.title: Heap-based buffer overflow in WebP in Pillow
vulnerabilities.description: Critical buffer overflow in WebP image processing allowing remote code execution.
